tool_args.rationale: The high-gradient observations indicate a threshold-dependent decline. Fit a source-supported square-root siphon branch and an estimated power-law avalanche jointly, then test the revised mechanism on fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Fresh confirmation RMSE was 0.629354, above tolerance; the branch or transition needs revision.
Neither naturally accounts for the observed negative high-gradient response while retaining the low-gradient saturation.
The available batch has already been acquired and did not target the high-gradient transition; fit the observed regime before buying more measurements.
One stationary model was refuted, but the observations do not establish non-stationarity or refute all smooth stationary mechanisms.
